criteria.text: No NavigationSidebar is rendered beside feature content; global navigation occupies the shell header and returns the former sidebar width to content.
Existing selected index values 0–9 and all routes/views remain unchanged; notification/deep-link callbacks that assign selectedIndex continue to work.

Wide windows show all workspace destinations as text-first tabs; as width or text scale reduces space, lower-priority destinations move progressively into More before tabs can wrap, with every destination still reachable.
If an overflow destination is active, More has selected treatment and the active menu item is marked.
Messages unread badge remains live through MessagesController.totalUnreadCount.
Settings remains reachable through the existing account/settings control and is not a workspace tab.
criteria.reason: AJ manually smoke-tested the desktop navigation; Settings remained reachable through the account control and absent from workspace tabs.

criteria.text: Tabs/menu are keyboard focusable and expose selected semantics; no color-only selection.
No new dependency, routing abstraction, or unrelated redesign.
criteria.reason: Owned diff review and final UI/UX review found no unrelated redesign or release-blocking regression.

criteria.text: At 1024x700 and 200% text scale, navigation does not overflow or scale labels down; overflow destinations remain under More on a single compact row.
Unread messages use an accessible compliant indicator rather than 10px white text on danger.
At the rendered-smoke 1024px width and 200% text scale, More remains on the single 48px navigation row rather than wrapping below the visible tabs.

Remove the artificial 50/50 nav/Spacer allocation. Navigation receives all width remaining before BackgroundActivityIndicator and _TopRightAccountCluster, with only a small fixed intentional gap if needed.
At AJ’s current wide smoke width, show Facilities, Automations, Integrations, and Agents whenever their measured tab widths fit. More contains only true overflow and disappears when all ten fit.
Preserve strict one-row 48–56px header, no Wrap/shrinking/clipping. At narrower widths overflow progressively into More.
Preserve right controls, messages badge, indices, active overflow state.

Implement the approved restrained selected treatment: transparent/quiet tab with 2px accent underline; do not render the persistent accent-filled pill seen in smoke. Keyboard focus remains independently outlined/visible. Hover may use accentMuted.

Add a full-shell or equivalent layout regression proving nav max width is not halved by Spacer and all tabs appear at representative wide width; retain 1024/200% one-row test. Test complete header composition sufficiently to catch this exact blank-space bug.
